name: azcon-energy-mcp
description: Real-time Brazilian corporate dossiers (CNPJ, QSA Partners, Capital), estimated electricity consumption (kWh/month), and high-precision solar photovoltaic physics (PVGIS / ANEEL / EDP-ES). Powered by HTTP 402 (x402) micropayments on Base and Solana.

tools.name: get_brazilian_company_energy_profile
tools.description: Fetch official Brazilian company data (CNPJ, QSA partners, legal status, capital) enriched with estimated monthly electricity consumption (kWh) and rooftop solar photovoltaic viability.

cnpj.description: 14-digit Brazilian CNPJ number (with or without punctuation)

tools.name: calculate_solar_geometry_and_yield
tools.description: Calculate solar photovoltaic yield, optimal tilt, azimuth, PVGIS European Joint Research Commission radiation, and ANEEL electricity bill savings.

city.description: City name in Brazil (e.g. Vitória, Serra, Linhares, São Paulo)

uf.description: 2-letter state code (e.g. ES, SP, RJ, MG)

tools.name: get_aneel_tariff_benchmark
tools.description: Get current homologated electricity tariffs from ANEEL (National Electric Energy Agency) for EDP Espírito Santo and Southeastern distribution concessions, including TE, TUSD, and Fio B transition status.

concessionaire.description: Electricity distributor (e.g. EDP-ES, Enel, Cemig, Light)
